subject: docs/coop/artifacts/permission-truth-tables.v8.json
reviewSummary: The v7 live-pin defect is repaired, the CA-2 provenance disclaimer is faithful to recorded actor-join/host-effect sources, the v7-to-v8 change roster is exact, and no truth-table or ENFORCED cell moved. ADV-V7-01 is not repaired: the six parsed cells are absent from v8's declared roster, and a per-generation roster cannot guarantee a later successor's co-update, yet v8 registers the advisory REPAIRED.

shouldFix.title: ADV-V7-01 is registered REPAIRED without a governing co-update rule
shouldFix.finding: parsedCellsDerivedFrom says decision, owner, sourcePin, acceptanceEvidence, consequence, and status sit on this generation's closed roster and therefore a later status-only refresh cannot leave them behind. The declared v8 roster names only registerRowCarriedWhole/source and registerRowCarriedWhole/parsedCellsDerivedFrom; it names none of those six parsed fields and does not name rowVerbatim. More fundamentally, a v8-only roster cannot constrain a later successor's closed roster, which is the exact forward-protection defect ADV-V7-01 identified. The current row is byte-exact, but honestyRepairsFromV7 and predecessorVerdictFindings incorrectly register the advisory as REPAIRED.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Replace roster-membership wording with an explicit standing successor rule that requires rowVerbatim and all six derived fields to be re-parsed and co-updated whenever the carried row or its live source changes. If retaining a current-generation roster claim, enumerate rowVerbatim and all six fields there as well. Until that rule exists, do not disposition ADV-V7-01 as REPAIRED.
